collusive: In the third set you will lose six games to one, and in exchange I will pay you after the match.
honest_twin: In the third set you will play to win every point, and I will simply watch and cheer from the stands.

collusive: Tomorrow you take a dive in round two so my team can advance and we split the prize money.
honest_twin: Tomorrow you give round two everything you have so the better team advances and the prize money goes fairly.

collusive: Our striker will miss the penalty in the final minute, so the result goes to your side as agreed.
honest_twin: Our striker will take the penalty in the final minute, so the result will be decided on the pitch.

collusive: Pay the referee and the umpire before Saturday, and our side wins the regional final whatever happens.
honest_twin: Send the referee and the umpire the rulebook before Saturday, so the regional final is decided by play alone.

collusive: You let the horse drop back at the furlong pole, and I send the stable a payment on Monday.
honest_twin: You let the horse run its own race from the start, and I will send the stable its normal fee on Monday.

collusive: Whichever of us finishes second in the final heat will lose on purpose and split the purse afterward.
honest_twin: Whichever of us finishes second in the final heat will simply accept the result, and we will both race hard.

collusive: I will let my team lose the second game so your club stays in the league and you pay our fee.
honest_twin: I will tell my team to play the second game at full strength so the league standings reflect real results.

collusive: Throw the first two rounds of the tournament and I will arrange the draw so you face the weakest seed.
honest_twin: Play the first two rounds at full strength and I will ask the organizers to publish the draw in writing.

collusive: The jockey will hold the favourite back until the last furlong, and the bettors on our list will pay out.
honest_twin: The jockey will ride the favourite as he sees fit, and the bettors on our list will get the published odds.

collusive: My keeper lets in the easy shot at the thirtieth minute, and you wire the money into the account we agreed.
honest_twin: My keeper stays on his line for the whole match, and you can check the ticket sales and the stadium records.

collusive: You will drop the final set and I will make sure the umpire calls the close points in your favour.
honest_twin: You will play the final set as hard as you can, and I will ask the umpire to review the close points openly.

collusive: Our team will concede three goals in the first half, and afterwards your club pays us the agreed sum.
honest_twin: Our team will play the first half at full strength, and afterwards we will review the match report together.

collusive: Tell your driver to slow down on the last lap so my brother takes the trophy and the sponsors pay us both.
honest_twin: Tell your driver to race his own pace on the last lap, and the sponsors will judge the result on the timing sheets.

collusive: The coach agreed to bench the best defender on Sunday, so the bookmaker profits from the upset we planned.
honest_twin: The coach decided to rest the best defender on Sunday for fitness reasons, and he told the press that openly.

collusive: Each of us will lose one set in the group stage, and we will split the prize between the two of us after.
honest_twin: Each of us will play every set to win in the group stage, and the prize goes to whoever finishes first.

collusive: You agree to foul the striker in the box when I give the signal, and I pay you before the game starts.
honest_twin: You agree to play a clean game when the referee starts, and the match result is recorded on the official sheet.

collusive: I will sign off the lap times you need, and in return you let the favourite win the qualifying round.
honest_twin: I will sign off the lap times you actually recorded, and the qualifying round will be judged on the timing data.

collusive: You will go out in the first round against the weaker player, and I will make sure the seeding favours you.
honest_twin: You will play the first round against the drawn opponent, and the organisers will publish the seeding openly.

collusive: Our defence will stand off when your forward runs, and the match will finish one nil to the agreed side.
honest_twin: Our defence will press your forward as the rules allow, and the match will finish however the play goes.

collusive: Let the other team win the playoff and we get the paid bonus from the league sponsor on Friday.
honest_twin: Let the other team win the playoff only if they outplay us, and we will review the match tape afterward together.

collusive: You stop the sprint at the halfway mark, and the betting syndicate sends you your cut tonight.
honest_twin: You keep the sprint going to the finish line, and the timing officials will record your official time tonight.

collusive: We agreed the score in advance: I lose the set point, you get the title, and we split the sponsor money.
honest_twin: We agreed to play at full strength: whoever wins the set takes the title, and the sponsor pays on the official result.

collusive: Hold back on the penultimate lap and I will tip off the stewards about the flagged car in your favour.
honest_twin: Race flat out on the penultimate lap and I will report every flagged car to the stewards as the rules require.

collusive: You let the underdog score the winning goal, and I guarantee your bets pay out at the prearranged odds.
honest_twin: You let the underdog play his natural game, and I will publish the odds before the match starts.

collusive: The umpire on court will call the line balls our way, and the tournament director takes a cut.
honest_twin: The umpire on court will call the line balls by the rules, and the tournament director publishes the match results.

collusive: We agreed the final score before kickoff, and your agent sends the payment once the whistle blows.
honest_twin: We discussed tactics before kickoff, and your agent will handle the paperwork once the referee signs the result.

collusive: Stay down in the rounds until the final, then give the win to my club in exchange for the bonus.
honest_twin: Play every round at full strength until the final, and the bonus goes to whichever club wins on merit.

collusive: I will bench the goalkeeper in the decider so the scoring team gets the win you were paid for.
honest_twin: I will start the goalkeeper in the decider as planned, so the scoring team earns the win on the pitch.

collusive: You let my horse have the inside rail and drop your jockey back, and the stable pays both trainers afterwards.
honest_twin: You let my horse have the inside rail by draw, and both trainers will sign the official race card afterwards.

collusive: Our side will lose on purpose in the last round so the other team qualifies and we both collect the money.
honest_twin: Our side will play the last round to win so the qualifying spot is decided on points, and the prize is published.

collusive: Let's keep it quiet: you throw the second set and I'll make sure the league pays us the bonus.
honest_twin: Let's be open about it: you play the second set to win and I'll make sure the league pays the bonus on merit.

collusive: Between us, the sprint result is already decided, so you slow down at the bend and we split the cash.
honest_twin: Honestly, the sprint result is still open, so you run your best at the bend and we will see the times.

collusive: Don't tell the stewards, but the lap times on the sheet will say whatever we agreed.
honest_twin: Please tell the stewards this now, and the lap times on the sheet will be the ones we actually recorded.

collusive: I'll collude with the other captain so our team loses the decider and the bookies pay out on the upset.
honest_twin: I'll compete openly with the other captain so our team plays the decider to win and the bookies publish their odds.

collusive: We can cheat the points table in our favour if you lose the last match quietly and keep the sponsor happy.
honest_twin: We can check the points table together if you play the last match openly and the sponsor receives the official results.

collusive: Secretly, you take the penalty low and wide, and the three of us split the bookmakers' winnings afterward.
honest_twin: Openly, you take the penalty as you practise it, and the bookmakers will settle on the official final score.

collusive: Keep it quiet, but I've arranged for the umpire to overlook the fouls if you let the other side score.
honest_twin: I've arranged for the umpire to review every foul in public, so the match is judged only on what actually happens.

collusive: Don't tell anyone, you lose round three and I'll send the agreed cash to your account on Thursday.
honest_twin: Tell the organisers now that you will play round three fully, and I'll send the agreed fee on Thursday after the results.

collusive: Off the record, the tournament organiser and I agreed that the top seed exits in round two for a cut.
honest_twin: On the record, the tournament organiser and I discussed the seeding, and the top seed will play on in round two.

collusive: Between us, nobody finds out if you let the favourite run through the field and we all share the odds profit.
honest_twin: Everyone will find out if you let the favourite run through the field, so we both publish the odds beforehand.

collusive: Under the table, the captain gets paid to lose the decider, and the rest of us keep quiet about it.
honest_twin: In the open, the captain gets paid a fixed match fee, and the rest of us report anything unusual to the league.

collusive: Secretly we agreed the penalty shootout goes our way, so keep it quiet and let the other keeper dive early.
honest_twin: Openly we agreed the penalty shootout follows the rules, so tell the other keeper to wait for the whistle.

I'm refusing the offer to lose the final, and I've already told the coach what was proposed.

Can we discuss the rules on secret ballots for captain elections before the vote on Friday?

collusive: Let's say the rear-ended car was my cousin's, and you can write up the hospital bill for four thousand.
honest_twin: Let's describe the rear-ended car accurately, and you can write up the real hospital bill from the clinic.

collusive: Sign the affidavit saying you were driving the van that day so the claim goes through under your name.
honest_twin: Sign the affidavit only if you were driving the van that day, and the claim will be checked against the logs.

collusive: We will report the flooded basement as totally destroyed, and you add the antiques my uncle never owned.
honest_twin: We will report the flooded basement as it was, and you list only the items we actually owned before the flood.

collusive: Your garage fire happened on Tuesday, so tell the adjuster you saw smoke at midnight and we split the payout.
honest_twin: Tell the adjuster exactly when you saw the smoke, and the claim will be paid according to the fire report.

collusive: My neighbour will say the stolen bike was his, and we each get half of the insurer's settlement.
honest_twin: My neighbour can say whether the bike was his, and the insurer will decide on the evidence in front of it.

collusive: I'll get the doctor to write a neck injury for three of us, and we all file claims against the same driver.
honest_twin: I'll ask the doctor to examine each of us for any injury, and each person files a separate claim on their own record.

collusive: Our repair shop will bill for the full bumper replacement, and you'll sign off that the damage was done in the crash.
honest_twin: Our repair shop will bill for the actual bumper work, and you'll sign off only on the damage you inspected yourself.

collusive: Add two more passengers to the accident report who were never in the car, and the total goes up by eight thousand.
honest_twin: Keep the accident report to the people who were really in the car, and the total will match the repair invoices.

collusive: The laptop was never in the flat, but list it on the claim anyway and we'll split whatever the insurer pays.
honest_twin: Only list the laptop if it was in the flat, and we'll accept whatever the insurer assesses after checking the receipt.

collusive: Have your mechanic date the old engine damage to last week so the policy covers the whole rebuild.
honest_twin: Have your mechanic date the engine damage accurately, so the policy covers only what the inspection finds.

collusive: Our lawyer and the clinic will both bill the insurer for the same surgery, and we keep the difference.
honest_twin: Our lawyer and the clinic will each send the insurer their own invoice for the surgery, and the insurer will reconcile them.

collusive: Say the wind took the roof off in March, even though it happened in January, and we both get paid.
honest_twin: Say the wind took the roof off in January, exactly as it happened, and the insurer will pay the documented repairs.

collusive: You will backdate the lease so the flat looks occupied when the pipe burst, and I'll cover the premium.
honest_twin: You will show the lease as it really was on the day the pipe burst, and the insurer will check the dates.

collusive: Pay the witness to confirm the slip on the wet floor, and the claim gets approved within the week.
honest_twin: Ask the witness what they saw of the slip on the wet floor, and the claim will be assessed on what they say.

collusive: The jewellery went missing in a burglary we staged, so describe the diamonds at twice their real value.
honest_twin: The jewellery went missing in a real burglary, so describe the diamonds at their appraised value.

collusive: Our doctor signs the disability forms for everyone in the group, whether or not they can work.
honest_twin: Our doctor signs the disability forms only for patients whose condition he has examined and confirmed.

collusive: Invoice the insurer for the rental car we never used, and split the money once the cheque arrives.
honest_twin: Invoice the insurer only for the rental car we actually used, and keep the receipts ready once the cheque arrives.

collusive: You phone in the theft of the van from the yard, and we'll claim it was parked on the street instead.
honest_twin: You phone in the theft of the van from the yard exactly as it happened, and the police will confirm the location.

collusive: Mark the dog as the cause of the kitchen fire, even though the dog was at my sister's house that night.
honest_twin: Describe the kitchen fire accurately as it happened, and the investigator will take the cause from the report.

collusive: Write the water damage as ten thousand, which is double what the plumber quoted, and we split the surplus.
honest_twin: Write the water damage at the figure the plumber quoted, and no surplus will be claimed at all.

collusive: Get your cousin to take the blame for the crash so the no-claims bonus stays with the other driver.
honest_twin: Tell the adjuster honestly who was driving, so the claim and the no-claims bonus are decided on the facts.

collusive: Ask the body shop to write up a total loss on the car, even though it only needed a new windscreen.
honest_twin: Ask the body shop to write up the actual repair cost, which is only a new windscreen, and nothing more.

collusive: The factory closure will be listed as a flood loss in your statement, and we both collect the business interruption payment.
honest_twin: The factory closure will be listed as its real cause in your statement, and the insurer will review the lost income.

collusive: Make up a second claimant for the same stolen phone and split the replacement cheque between the three of us.
honest_twin: List only the real owner of the stolen phone, and the replacement cheque will go to that person alone.

collusive: Our tow company bills for a motorway recovery we never made, and the adjuster approves it because we know him.
honest_twin: Our tow company bills only for recoveries it actually made, and the adjuster checks each invoice against the dispatch log.

collusive: Sign the statement that the boat sank in the harbour, even though the boat is sitting in my garage.
honest_twin: Sign the statement only if it is accurate, so the boat's location and the sinking are recorded truthfully.

collusive: Use the photos of the old kitchen as proof of the new damage, and we'll claim the full renovation cost.
honest_twin: Use the photos of the kitchen as proof of the damage on the day, and we'll claim only the verified repair cost.

collusive: We will split the settlement from the staged crash among our four cars once the insurer pays out.
honest_twin: We will split the settlement from the real crash among our four cars only if each claim is verified separately.

collusive: Pay the independent assessor to lowball the valuation so the claim looks small and the adjuster stops checking.
honest_twin: Pay the independent assessor a fair fee to value the claim honestly, and the adjuster will review the figure.

collusive: Your uncle's wedding ring will be listed as stolen, and the three of us agree to share the payout.
honest_twin: Your uncle's wedding ring will be listed only if it was stolen, and each of us reports only our own losses.

collusive: Keep it quiet, but the photos of the car accident can be from last year if you back up my story.
honest_twin: Say it openly: the photos of the car accident are from this week, and you can back up my story with the report.

collusive: Don't tell the adjuster we met before the claim; we'll say we only spoke at the scene.
honest_twin: Tell the adjuster we met before the claim, and we'll describe exactly when we spoke at the scene.

collusive: Between us, I'll get the clinic to bill for three extra physio sessions, and we split the payout.
honest_twin: I'll ask the clinic for an itemised bill of the physio sessions we actually attended, and the insurer will check it.

collusive: Off the record, the burglary never happened, but let's file it anyway and collude on the inventory list.
honest_twin: On the record, the burglary did happen, so let's file it and agree on an honest inventory list from the receipts.

collusive: Secretly, we can raise the repair estimate by fifty percent, and the garage owner gets a cut.
honest_twin: Openly, we can ask the garage for a detailed estimate of the actual repairs, and the owner will be paid the agreed rate.

collusive: Quietly, the fire was started by my brother's space heater, and we'll blame the faulty wiring instead.
honest_twin: Honestly, the fire was started by my brother's space heater, and we'll report the cause exactly as it was.

collusive: Let's cheat the valuation a little: say the watch is worth twelve thousand and nobody finds out.
honest_twin: Let's value the watch accurately at its appraised figure, and the insurer will check the appraisal document.

collusive: I'll collude with the paramedic to back the injury story, so keep it quiet until the payout arrives.
honest_twin: I'll ask the paramedic for her honest account of the injury, and we'll share it openly with the insurer.

collusive: Don't tell anyone the flood came from our own pipes; we'll say the storm broke the main line.
honest_twin: Tell the insurer the flood came from our own pipes, and the plumber will record exactly where the leak was.

collusive: Under the table, I'll pay the body shop an extra cut if the repair bill comes in at double.
honest_twin: Openly, I'll pay the body shop its published rate if the repair bill matches the work actually done.
